2fa995c.summary: Returns the banned card IDs by projecting each banned-card reference to its string ID with LINQ Select; decompiled output is mostly inlined LINQ type-check noise.

2fa9b20.summary: Finds the battle arena configured for the given army, falling back to the default arena if none matches.

2faa2e4.summary: Builds a dictionary mapping each card tier to its frame reference, logging an error on duplicates, then clears a temporary army dictionary.

2fa9f48.summary: Loads and returns the frame and highlight sprites for the given card type.

2faa1fc.summary: Releases the frame and highlight addressable references for the given card type.

2faa548.summary: Outputs the frame and highlight asset references matching the card type (troop for minion/hero, stratagem for tactic).

2fa9c0c.summary: Returns the frame and highlight sprites for an army, tier and card type, building the cache first if empty.

2faa028.summary: Releases the cached card frame sprites for an army, tier and card type if the cache is populated.

2fa9df4.summary: Clears and rebuilds the per-army card frame cache from the clan frames, logging errors on duplicate keys.

2faa7f8.summary: Releases the cursor and highlight assets for this entry if its army matches, warning if the asset was not loaded.

2faa5f8.summary: Looks up the cursor and highlight sprites for an army, loading them from the matching entry, or returns false with nulls.

2faa788.summary: Releases the cursor assets of the entry matching the given army, warning if the highlight asset was not loaded.

2faa8a4.summary: Finds the default cardback cosmetic item for an army by iterating the cardback entries.

2faaa10.summary: Returns the cardback sprite pair for an army, or two nulls if no default cardback exists.

2faaae8.summary: Releases the default cardback image and SDF assets for an army, warning if the SDF asset was not loaded.

2faab94.summary: Finds the environmental effect scenario condition for a card by matching army and card ID, then loads its addressable asset.

2faad58.summary: Returns the empty offensive card for the given army from the environmental effects data (decompiler merged in following functions).

2faadc0.summary: Builds a list of environmental effect cards for an army, choosing offensive or defensive cards depending on flags and owned-card rules.

2fab05c.summary: Builds a draft list of environmental effect cards for an army, adding offensive, defensive or empty cards depending on flags.

2fab4c8.summary: Finds the sprite for an army among the army icon entries and loads it, returning null if none match.

2fab670.summary: Finds the army icon entry matching the army and releases its addressable sprite.

2fabd18.summary: Copies the icon name localized string fields out into the return value.

2fabc2c.summary: Finds the scoring icon matching a scoring item type using LINQ FirstOrDefault; most of the body is decompiler noise from inlined enumerator and exception handling.

2fc6974.summary: Initializes a starter deck selection container with deck info, glow color, click listener, army objects, hero image and description.

2fc6c50.summary: Toggles the selected visual state of the deck container: scales hero image, fades glow, shows highlights and sets button interactable.

2fc6ee8.summary: On disable, releases the loaded full hero sprite of the current deck's hero, warning if it was not loaded.

2fc798c.summary: Copies the deck info localized string fields into the return value.

2fc79b4.summary: Predicate returning whether a campaign's army matches the army of the currently selected deck's hero.

2fc7a38.summary: After starter deck is granted, collects rewards, saves selected army, records first campaign node progress, sets default deck and closes the window.
